title: Configuration with a memory tape at a seam
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean input list, $l$ a program node, $v\colon\mathrm{Fin}(m)\to\mathbb N$ a register assignment, $M\colon\mathbb Z\to\{0,1\}$ a memory tape, $p\in\mathbb Z$ its head position, and $out$ a Boolean output list. The construction forms a configuration on input $x$ with $m+k_D+1$ work tapes by taking the seam configuration associated with $x,l,v,out$ and adjoining a memory tape whose contents are the optional-symbol encoding of $M$ and whose head is at $p$.
caveat: The payload does not provide descriptions of the seam configuration or the tape encoding, so their precise contents beyond the displayed composition cannot be fully rendered.
